verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed a live llms.txt at developer.vanta.com that indexes the APIs, MCP server and integration guides. Doc pages are served as .md files that point agents back to that index. Vanta also publishes agentskills.io-spec skill files and a Developer Docs MCP server that searches the docs and serves every page as a skill.md resource. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (probe got 404s), no independent community corroboration of agents using the docs in practice.
